name: gc-collect-dead-worktree-and-snapshot-window
body: A dead worktree's refs/scans/deps rows are never removed - only its bodies and units are collected - so its manifest rows linger; and the read view is taken before the write transaction opens, so a unit another worktree reuses and commits a manifest for in that window can be collected (the next scan re-derives it: a cache miss, never a wrong fact). Upgrade when `WriteTxn::remove_worktree` should be driven from the collector, or when taking the write transaction before the snapshot is confirmed safe for redb readers.
